podcast.title: Born a Woman Theory
podcast.body: As part of the wider Fall Out Boy clone conspiracy theory, it is alleged that the man-made clone replacing Patrick Stump was actually born a woman. "Oh, did I mention that bad-made Patrick Stump was actually born a woman?"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Entire Band Clone Theory
xref.body: Building on the Pete Wentz clone theory, some conspiracy theorists allege that all members of Fall Out Boy are dead and have been replaced by man-made humans. Additionally, it is claimed that the cloned Patrick Stump was originally born a woman. "Turns out that all of the members of follow up boy are dead Pete was just the last one to go and Oh, did I mention that bad-made Patrick Stump was actually born a woman?"
